patch.value: First-class conflict objects stored in changes

Opt-in merge recording stores one content-addressed object per conflicting structured field or text hunk, referenced by the tree alongside readable merged content. Existing fail-on-conflict behavior is preserved. Includes explicit tip resolution.

Conflict units preserve base/ours/theirs and independent edits merge; conflicted snapshots remain committable and transportable; status/show/log/items report units in TOON and JSON; verify, GC, erasure and bounded history retain or safely deny the complete closure; real tracker proof and behavioural revert proofs pass unchanged npm and Bun release gates.
